about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Greenman Association
about.heroQuote: Every choice you make is a vote for the world you want to live in.
about.visionLead: The world is changing. We choose to stand at the very front of that change.
about.visionBody:
Extreme climate events are breaking records. The cost of living is rising. Families feel the weight of it all. We see this — and we see something else, something more important:

Deep inside people, there is an unextinguished desire to live with goodness.

Greenman Association was born at this crossroads. We don't just talk about eco-values — we build a real, livable system where "caring for the Earth" also means "caring for your wallet," "caring for your health," and "caring for your community."

We believe that real change is never lonely. When each person begins to make small choices — choosing clean food, passing a toy to another child, letting their mind find stillness — these forces gather and create ripples that the whole world can feel.
about.pillar1Desc: We build direct green supply chains so every purchase goes straight back to the land and the farmers — not disappearing into layers of profit.
about.pillar2Desc: "Inner peace shapes outer reality" is our root. External change must begin from inner clarity. A healthy mind is the deepest foundation of sustainable living.
about.pillar3Desc: Every community has idle resources, lonely people, and unmet needs. We use the G-Coin system to reconnect this energy, enabling real mutual support between neighbors.
about.mission: Environmental protection isn't just about recycling — it's about inner transformation. When individuals find inner peace, they naturally reduce wasteful consumption and achieve sustainable living.
about.closingStatement: We are not waiting for a better world — we are building it, together.
